name: Dispatch
summary: Routes any paragraph into custom choices configured by prompt, with calibrated probabilities.
caption: Configurable System 1 decision router

name: Gatekeeper
summary: Checks every LLM request: blocks prompt injection, masks identifiers, routes easy prompts to a small model.
caption: OpenAI-compatible LLM security gateway

name: Lens
summary: Finds pictures from English or Indonesian text or an image, plus custom picture indexing in Typesense.
caption: Multimodal vector search in Typesense

name: Ledger
summary: Reads supplier invoices with a vision model, verifies every sum in code, matches bank debits.
caption: Invoice extraction and bank reconciliation

name: Footfall
summary: Counts people crossing a camera line and times how long they wait, with every head blurred.
caption: Camera line counting and dwell timing
